title: Complete entitlement policy and separate admin lifecycle
acceptance_criteria: Complete centralized request- and commit-time policy and owner banner: equality at expiry closes mutations/public intake while approved owner/receipt reads remain available; unavailable, unknown and outage responses are distinct and demo/lab/marketing stay independent.

Provide separate PlatformAdmin identities, cookie, UI, guarded API and secret-safe out-of-band bootstrap. Versioned access changes audit actor/time/old/new/reason atomically, without impersonation or order PII access.

Prove the clock-controlled operation matrix, separate identities/cookies, role rejection, admin concurrency conflicts, stale open checkout deny, and persistent audit/reactivation limited to the intended tenant.
deliverables: Entitlement matrix, separate admin bootstrap/UI/API, audit migration and phase-5 gate evidence
